text: 上海银行业跨境金融业务持续拓展，离岸金融创新、跨境结算便利化和跨国公司全球资金管理等领域迎来新进展。 10月13日，上海市银行同业公会举办“跨境金融赋能高水平对外开放 助力上海国际金融中心能级提升”新闻通气会。中国银行上海市分行、进出口银行上海分行、农业银行上海市分行、中信银行上海分行、浦发银行上海分行、渣打中国、花旗中国等七家银行介绍了跨境金融业务发展情况。
text_en: Shanghai's banking sector continues to expand cross-border financial services, with new progress in offshore financial innovation, facilitation of cross-border settlement and global fund management for multinational companies. On October 13, the Shanghai Banking Association held a news briefing titled "Cross-border finance empowering high-level opening-up and helping raise the level of Shanghai International Financial Center." Seven banks—Bank of China Shanghai Branch, Export-Import Bank of China Shanghai Branch, Agricultural Bank of China Shanghai Branch, CITIC Bank Shanghai Branch, Shanghai Pudong Development Bank Shanghai Branch, Standard Chartered China and Citibank China—presented on the development of their cross-border financial businesses.
